text_block_list.text:
Today is the start of summer camp,
where racers
train to improve their skills.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I can't believe it's been a whole
year! Man,
this place sure brings back
memories.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Remember how panicked you were
about me last
year? Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm just messin' with ya. Honestly, now
that I think
of it, that was probably my
fault.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that did happen, didn't it...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't done enough to make sure you
had full
faith in me then.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
How are you feeling now, though? You
aren't
feelin' anxious or anything, are
you?

Hishi Amazon's skills are nothing short of
 amazing. Her performance at the Osaka
Hai and
the Yasuda Kinen completely
astounded me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, well that's good to hear!

And so, Hishi Amazon's blazing summer
camp
begins!
